author: Infivix
body:
Ok, I'm trying to play a game on Luar, and this kid HighlandNJ_James is abusing a glitch where he's invisible and is able to punch me. Then, he starts spawn killing with the diamond armor he killed me for (as a spec).

http://imgur.com/pzsFqQh

As you can see from the screenshot, he killed me with his fists the first time, then took my diamond armor and started spawn killing. The game ended right after luckily.
 (Btw, I was on my alt XtremYoshi at the time.) Thank you for reading this.
